description: This file defines the interface for handling packed references within a version control system, including functions for initialization, locking, unlocking, size retrieval, and transaction necessity checks related to packed refs.

methods.name: packed_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes the packed reference store for a given repository and directory with specified flags.

methods.name: packed_refs_lock
methods.description: Locks the packed-refs file for writing, returning 0 on success and an error code on failure.

methods.name: packed_refs_unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the packed-refs file.

methods.name: packed_refs_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if the packed-refs file is currently locked.

methods.name: packed_refs_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the packed-refs file, returning 0 if it does not exist.

methods.name: is_packed_transaction_needed
methods.description: Determines whether a reference transaction needs to be applied to a packed reference store, given that the store is locked.

calls: return a nonzero value on error
